title: Saucer News, March 1963 (Vol. 10, No. 1): cartoon of saucer landing and astronauts
description: Front page of "Saucer News," the "Official Publication of the Saucer and Unexplained Celestial Events Research Society," Volume 10, Number 1, March 1963, edited by James W. Moseley. It features a cartoon illustration of a large dotted flying saucer on the ground, a rocket, two small figures in spacesuits, and an exploding object. The text is a letter about the delayed publication of a book titled "The Second Coming of Christ and Flying Saucers," followed by an editor's note.
